cards.text: Right after Jesus drives out a spirit His disciples couldn't drive out (Mark 9:14-29), they go on from there and pass through Galilee, and Jesus doesn't want anyone to know. JESUS sneaking through Galilee is like slipping out of the office party when everybody in the building knows your name.

cards.question: Jesus doesn't want anyone to know He's passing through Galilee, because He was ___ His disciples.

cards.text: And the lesson is a heavy one, friend. Jesus tells them, "The Son of Man will be delivered into the hands of men."

cards.question: Jesus says the Son of Man will be delivered into the hands of men. What does He say those men will do to Him?
But that's not the end. Jesus tells His disciples that after ___ days He will rise.

cards.text: That is a LOT to hear on a walk. And the disciples don't understand what He means.

cards.question: The disciples don't understand what Jesus told them about the Son of Man, so they ask Him to explain it.

cards.text: Nope. They're afraid to ask Him about it, like that meeting where something huge gets said and EVERY hand in the room stays down.
Then they come to Capernaum. In the house, Jesus asks them, "What were you discussing on the way?"

cards.question: When Jesus asks the disciples what they were discussing on the way to Capernaum, they tell Him right away.

cards.text: Silence. A room full of grown men suddenly VERY interested in the floor, because on the way they'd been arguing about something.

cards.question: On the way to Capernaum, what were the disciples arguing about?

answers.text: Which of them was the greatest
Why they couldn't drive out the spirit
Who would carry the money bag

cards.text: Arguing over who's the greatest. While walking with JESUS. That's two new hires arguing over who's the real boss in the back seat of the CEO's car, while the CEO drives.

cards.question: Jesus sits down and calls the Twelve over. He says if anyone wants to be first, he must be the ___ of all and the servant of all.

cards.text: Then Jesus has a little child stand among them. Right in the middle of the who's-the-greatest crowd.

cards.question: Jesus has a little child stand among the disciples. What does He do with the child?

answers.text: Takes the child in His arms

cards.text: Holding the child, Jesus says, "Whoever welcomes one of these little children in My name welcomes Me…" They argued about who's the greatest, and Jesus is talking about welcoming a child.

cards.question: Jesus says whoever welcomes Him welcomes not only Him, but also the One who sent Him.

cards.text: Jesus is still with His disciples when John, one of them, speaks up. He says, "Teacher, we saw someone else driving out demons in Your name…"

cards.question: John tells Jesus that when they saw the man driving out demons in Jesus' name, they tried to stop him.
John says they tried to stop the man driving out demons in Jesus' name. Why?

answers.text: He was one of the scribes

cards.text: That's yelling at the guy from accounting for fixing the jammed printer, just because he's not from IT. But Jesus tells John not to stop him.

cards.question: Jesus tells John not to stop the man, because the man will soon join the Twelve.

cards.text: Here's His reason: no one who performs a miracle in His name can turn around and speak evil of Him. Then Jesus sums it all up in one short line.

cards.question: Jesus sums up who's on the disciples' side in one short line. What does He say?

answers.text: Whoever is not against us is for us
Whoever is not with us is against us
Whoever walks with us is for us

cards.text: Then Jesus goes even smaller. He talks about anyone who gives the disciples even a cup of water because they bear the name of Christ.

cards.question: Jesus says the one who gives a cup of water because the disciples bear the name of Christ will never lose his ___.

cards.text: A cup of WATER, friend, and the reward is never lost! Then Jesus turns serious about anyone who causes one of these little ones who believe in Him to stumble.

cards.question: Jesus says it would be better for anyone who causes one of these little ones who believe in Him to stumble to have a large millstone hung around his neck and be thrown into the sea.

cards.text: Jokes down for this one, friend, because Jesus says, "If your hand causes you to sin, cut it off." He says it's better to enter life crippled than to have two hands and go into hell, into the unquenchable fire.

cards.question: After the hand, Jesus warns about two more things that can cause you to sin: your ___ and your ___.
If your eye causes you to sin, Jesus says it's better to enter where with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell?

cards.text: Then Jesus says hell is where "their worm never dies, and the fire is never quenched." Count the word never in there, friend, because it shows up twice.
Then Jesus says, "For everyone will be salted with fire." And from there, He turns to salt.

cards.question: Jesus says salt is good. What does He say can happen to it?
Jesus finishes by telling the disciples to have ___ among themselves and be at ___ with one another.
